interest: Shows 1930s Japanese cultural diplomacy: Hitler's gift of a Kyoto painting to Hirohito, and tracking of Viscount Ishii's memoirs.
overview: Docket (1931-36) on Japanese history and relics: the English translation of Viscount Ishii's memoirs, Hitler's gift of a Kyoto painting to Hirohito, and photographs of the Buddhist Daihannyakyo relic.
